# Luka Engels

> Lead Software Engineer in Hamburg, Germany, working fully remote. 25 years of production software across real estate SaaS, banking, insurance and telecommunications. Builds agentic SDLC platforms on large language models, with Claude skills, MCP servers and RAG retrieval, on a TypeScript and AWS foundation.

Luka Engels is Lead Software Engineer at Empro (Whise Group), where he holds the technical direction for a SaaS CRM for real estate brokers serving more than 6,000 customers, 95,000 users and 4.2 million managed properties. He leads six developers inside an eleven-person cross-functional team.

His team built and maintains an agentic SDLC platform: a harness of Claude skills, slash commands, hooks and rules that engineers work through daily, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and RAG retrieval connecting agents to repositories, pipelines and issue tracking. A stakeholder-approved prototype enters the pipeline through specification extraction; agents then groom, implement, review and test, with hooks and rules enforcing standards. The team also shipped a customer-facing agentic UI on the Agno framework in Python, and owns an Angular design system of 87 components in an Nx monorepo.

Earlier senior and leadership roles: immowelt GmbH / AVIV Group (2020 to 2024), neveling.net GmbH, now Neveling Reply (2015 to 2020), Spencer Stuart in Dublin (2014 to 2015), Clarity Consulting, since acquired by Perficient (2012 to 2014), Erste Group Bank AG, leading a team of 10 (2008 to 2012), Multilink (2004 to 2008) and Euris (2000 to 2004).

Primary stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, SQL. Node.js, NestJS, .NET Core, Angular, React, Nx. AWS with Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront and CDK, Azure Kubernetes Service, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, GitHub Actions. Practices: domain-driven design, microservices, event-driven architecture, TDD, Agile and Scrum, technical leadership and mentoring.

Education: Master of Economics, University of Rijeka. Certifications: MCSD and MCSA Web Applications.

Languages: Croatian (native), English (C2), Italian (C1), German (B2). Citizenship: German and Croatian, so no work authorisation or visa sponsorship is required anywhere in the EU.

Currently open to permanent, fully remote roles employed in Germany, at Staff, Principal, Lead or Head of Engineering level, where agentic and LLM platform work is the core of the job. Not looking for freelance or contract engagements, hybrid or on-site roles, or relocation.

## Writing
- [A Property Inquiry Agent with React, MCP, and Hybrid RAG](https://luka-engels.de/writing/proptech-inquiry-agent/): A TypeScript agent for property inquiries: answers backed by records, checked before delivery, with human follow-up when needed. Built with React, MCP, and hybrid RAG.
- [Catching AI Workflow Failures with Executable Playbooks](https://luka-engels.de/writing/gates-not-prompts/): A file-based delivery procedure for Claude Code and Codex that turns workflow preconditions into executable checks, with explicit limits.
